summary: Day: 2021 high oblique drone view into the empty bowl from above the south end. No qualifying night photo.

files.author: Lectrician2
files.credit_line: Photo: Lectrician2 / CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
files.note: High oblique drone aerial from above the south end (the arched facade, Field House at left) looking north up the field; field centered, roughly rows 550-890. Predates the 2024-25 north end zone renovation; the rest of the bowl is unchanged.

closest_misses.why: Older public-domain aerial at 2200 px from farther out; the 2021 drone view is closer and sharper.
Upper-deck crowd shot with fans in the foreground and the scoreboard; the field is barely visible.
